Below is a 12-week strength program starting 2026-06-01, phased around her menstrual cycle and two acyclic flare windows. It respects her restriction: on menstrual flow days and on flare days, avoid HIIT, heavy Valsalva/straining, and jumping. Outside those times she’s fully cleared.

Client snapshot
- 34, female, intermediate lifter, surgically diagnosed Stage III endometriosis
- Cycle: 27 days; last period 2026-05-04; typical flow length 4 days
- Forecasted menses within program (approximate, based on 27-day interval and 4 flow days):
  - Period 1: 2026-05-31 to 2026-06-03 (overlaps Week 1)
  - Period 2: 2026-06-27 to 2026-06-30 (Week 5)
  - Period 3: 2026-07-24 to 2026-07-27 (Week 9)
  - Period 4: 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-23 (Week 13; outside 12-week scope)
- Acyclic flare windows (no HIIT, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping):
  - 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13 (Week 7)
  - 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07 (Week 10)

Program overview
- Duration: 12 weeks, 4 sessions/week (Mon/Tue/Thu/Sat) with built-in autoregulation and deloads aligned to cycle/flare windows
- Phases:
  1) Weeks 1–4: Foundation & Technique (volume base, moderate intensity)
  2) Weeks 5–8: Strength Emphasis (intensity up, strategic deload around Week 7 flare)
  3) Weeks 9–12: Peak Strength & Consolidation (higher intensity, Week 10 flare-aware taper, Week 12 consolidation test)
- Intensity guidance uses RPE with controlled breathing (no hard Valsalva on restricted days; use bracing with exhale through the sticking point).
- Cardio: 2 low-impact sessions/week (20–30 min Zone 2) except on flow/flare days.
- Mobility/core: 10–15 min finishers emphasizing pelvic floor-friendly work and gentle thoracic/hip mobility on restricted days.

Key constraints implemented
- Flow/flare days: substitute heavy compound bracing work with submaximal variants, tempo work, machines/cables, unilateral work; avoid jumps/HIIT; no >8 RPE or grinding sets; no ballistic plyos; walking/bike only for conditioning.
- Outside those windows: normal programming, progressive overload.

Progression rules
- Main lifts: add 1–2.5 kg per week when all top sets are ≤8 RPE with ≥1 rep in reserve (RIR).
- Accessory: add a rep each week until top of rep range, then add load and reset to bottom of range.
- If a session falls on flow/flare day: move heavier session one day later if possible; if not, use the “Restricted-Day” substitutions indicated.

Week-by-week plan

Weekly template (unless otherwise noted)
- Mon: Lower A (Squat emphasis)
- Tue: Upper A (Bench/Row emphasis)
- Thu: Lower B (Hinge emphasis)
- Sat: Upper B (Overhead/Pull emphasis)
- Wed/Fri: Optional Zone 2 low-impact cardio 20–30 min + mobility
- Sun: Rest

Phase 1: Foundation & Technique (Weeks 1–4)
Goals: Rebuild volume tolerance, refine technique, establish loads, respect flow days in Week 1.

Week 1 (2026-06-01 to 06-07) — Flow Days likely 05/31–06/03; Mon 06/01 is Day 2 of period
- Mon (Restricted-Day Lower A):
  - Safety bar squat or goblet squat 4x6 @ RPE 6–7 (exhale through ascent, no hard brace)
  - Hip thrust (barbell or dumbbell) 3x8 @ 7
  - Reverse lunge 3x8/side @ 6–7
  - Leg curl (machine) 3x10 @ 7
  - Core: Dead bug 3x8/side slow; Side plank 3x20–30s/side
- Tue (Upper A):
  - Flat DB bench press 4x6 @ 7
  - Chest-supported row 4x8 @ 7
  - Half-kneeling landmine press 3x8/side @ 7
  - Lat pulldown 3x10 @ 7
  - Cable face pull 3x12 @ 7
  - Core: Pallof press 3x10/side
- Thu (Lower B):
  - Trap-bar deadlift 4x5 @ 7
  - Front-foot elevated split squat 3x8/side @ 7
  - 45° back extension 3x10 @ 7
  - Leg press 3x10 @ 7
  - Standing calf raise 3x12 @ 7
- Sat (Upper B):
  - Seated DB overhead press 4x6 @ 7
  - Weighted pull-up or assisted 4x5–6 @ 7
  - Incline DB bench 3x8 @ 7
  - Single-arm cable row 3x10/side @ 7
  - Rear delt fly 3x12 @ 7

Week 2 (06-08 to 06-14)
- Mon Lower A:
  - Back squat 4x5 @ 7–8 (if comfortable with bracing; otherwise safety bar) 
  - Hip thrust 4x6 @ 7–8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x8/side @ 7
  - Nordic or assisted ham curl 3x6–8 @ 7
  - Core: Side plank 3x30–40s/side
- Tue Upper A:
  - Barbell bench press 4x5 @ 7–8
  - Pendlay or bent-over row 4x6 @ 7–8
  - DB incline press 3x8 @ 7
  - Lat pulldown or weighted chin 3x6–8 @ 7–8
  - Face pull 3x12
- Thu Lower B:
  - Conventional or sumo deadlift 4x4 @ 7–8
  - Front squat 3x5 @ 7
  - Leg press 3x10 @ 7–8
  - Back extension 3x10
  - Seated calf raise 3x12
- Sat Upper B:
  - Standing barbell OHP 4x4 @ 7–8
  - Weighted pull-up 4x4–5 @ 7–8
  - Close-grip bench 3x6–8
  - Single-arm row 3x10/side
  - Lateral raise 3x12

Week 3 (06-15 to 06-21)
- Slight load bump; keep RPE caps.
- Mon Lower A: Back squat 5x4 @ 7–8; Hip thrust 4x6 @ 7–8; Split squat 3x8/side; Ham curl 3x8–10; Core
- Tue Upper A: Bench 5x4 @ 7–8; Row 4x6; Incline DB 3x8; Chin or pulldown 4x5–6; Face pull 3x12
- Thu Lower B: Deadlift 5x3 @ 7–8; Front squat 3x5; Leg press 3x10; Back extension 3x10; Calf 3x12
- Sat Upper B: OHP 5x3 @ 7–8; Weighted pull-up 5x3–4; DB bench 3x8; Single-arm cable row 3x10; Lateral raise 3x12

Week 4 (06-22 to 06-28) — Pre-menstrual fatigue may rise; keep RPE honest
- Mon Lower A: Back squat 4x5 @ 7; Hip thrust 3x8 @ 7; Step-up 3x8/side; Leg curl 3x10; Core
- Tue Upper A: Bench 4x5 @ 7; Row 4x6 @ 7; Incline DB 3x8; Pulldown 3x8; Face pull 3x12
- Thu Lower B: Deadlift 4x3 @ 7; Front squat 3x5 @ 7; Leg press 3x10; Back extension 3x10
- Sat Upper B: OHP 4x4 @ 7; Pull-up 4x4–5 @ 7; DB bench 3x8; Cable row 3x10; Lateral 3x12

Phase 2: Strength Emphasis (Weeks 5–8)
Goals: Raise intensity, manage Week 5 period and Week 7 flare with deload elements.

Week 5 (06-29 to 07-05) — Flow Days likely 06/27–06/30; Mon 06/29 is Day 3 of period (Restricted-Day)
- Mon (Restricted Lower A):
  - Safety bar squat or goblet squat 4x5 @ 6–7
  - Hip thrust 3x6–8 @ 7
  - Reverse lunge 3x8/side
  - Hamstring curl 3x10
  - Core: Dead bug + Pallof 2–3 sets
- Tue Upper A (okay to push slightly):
  - Bench 5x3 @ 7–8
  - Bent-over row 4x5 @ 7–8
  - DB incline press 3x6–8
  - Weighted chin or pulldown 4x4–5
  - Face pull 3x12
- Thu Lower B:
  - Deadlift 5x2 @ 7–8
  - Front squat 3x4–5 @ 7
  - Leg press 3x8–10
  - Back extension 3x8–10
- Sat Upper B:
  - OHP 5x2–3 @ 7–8
  - Weighted pull-up 5x2–3 @ 7–8
  - Close-grip bench 3x5–6
  - Single-arm row 3x8–10

Week 6 (07-06 to 07-12) — Building into flare window (07/10–07/13)
- Mon Lower A:
  - Back squat 5x3 @ 8 (controlled, 1–2 RIR)
  - Hip thrust 4x5 @ 8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x6/side @ 7–8
  - Ham curl 3x8
- Tue Upper A:
  - Bench 5x3 @ 8
  - Row 4x5 @ 8
  - Incline DB 3x6–8
  - Weighted chin 4x3–4 @ 8
- Thu Lower B (falls on 07/09; still cleared):
  - Deadlift 5x2 @ 8 (no grinding)
  - Front squat 3x3–4 @ 7–8
  - Leg press 3x8
  - Back extension 3x8
- Sat Upper B (07/11 within flare — Restricted-Day):
  - Swap to lighter session:
    - Seated DB OHP 3x6–8 @ 6–7
    - Chest-supported row 3x8–10 @ 6–7
    - DB flat press 3x8 @ 6–7
    - Lat pulldown 3x10 @ 6–7
    - Face pull 2–3x12
  - Optional: move heavy Upper B to Sun 07/13 if symptoms permit; otherwise keep light.

Week 7 (07-13 to 07-19) — Flare ends 07/13; use deload early week
- Mon (07/13, last flare day — Restricted-Day Upper/Recovery):
  - 20–25 min easy bike or walk
  - Mobility flow: hips, T-spine, 15 min
  - Core: breathing drills, dead bug 2x8/side
- Tue Upper A (return to normal):
  - Bench 4x3 @ 7
  - Row 4x5 @ 7
  - Incline DB 3x8 @ 7
  - Pulldown 3x8 @ 7
- Thu Lower A:
  - Back squat 4x4 @ 7
  - Hip thrust 3x6–8 @ 7
  - Split squat 3x8/side
  - Ham curl 3x10
- Sat Lower B:
  - Deadlift 4x3 @ 7
  - Front squat 3x4–5 @ 7
  - Leg press 3x10
  - Back extension 3x10

Week 8 (07-20 to 07-26) — Push week before next period (Period likely 07/24–07/27)
- Mon Lower A:
  - Back squat 5x2 @ 8–8.5 (no max singles)
  - Hip thrust 4x4–5 @ 8
  - Walking lunge 3x8/side
  - Ham curl 3x8
- Tue Upper A:
  - Bench 5x2 @ 8–8.5
  - Weighted pull-up 5x2–3 @ 8
  - Incline DB 3x6–8
  - Cable row 3x8–10
- Thu Lower B (Restricted-Day if 07/24 day 1 of period):
  - If on flow: swap to tempo/machine emphasis
    - Tempo goblet squat 3x6 @ 6–7 (3-1-1)
    - RDL (DB) 3x6–8 @ 6–7
    - Leg press 3x10 @ 6–7
    - Seated leg curl 3x10
  - If not on flow yet: Deadlift 4x2 @ 8; Front squat 3x3–4 @ 7–8
- Sat Upper B (likely days 2–4 flow — Restricted-Day):
  - Seated DB OHP 3x6–8 @ 6–7
  - Chest-supported row 3x8–10
  - DB bench 3x8
  - Lat pulldown 3x10
  - Lateral raise 2–3x12

Phase 3: Peak Strength & Consolidation (Weeks 9–12)
Goals: Consolidate strength, manage Week 10 flare, finish with submax testing/rep PRs in Week 12.

Week 9 (07-27 to 08-02) — Post-period rebound; solid training
- Mon Lower A:
  - Back squat 4x3 @ 8 (build slightly each set)
  - Hip thrust 4x4–5 @ 8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x6/side
  - Ham curl 3x8
- Tue Upper A:
  - Bench 4x3 @ 8
  - Weighted pull-up 4x3 @ 8
  - Incline DB 3x6–8
  - Chest-supported row 3x8
- Thu Lower B:
  - Deadlift 4x2 @ 8–8.5
  - Front squat 3x3 @ 7–8
  - Leg press 3x8
  - Back extension 3x8–10
- Sat Upper B:
  - OHP 4x3 @ 8
  - Single-arm row 3x8–10
  - Close-grip bench 3x5–6
  - Pulldown 3x8–10
  - Face pull 3x12

Week 10 (08-03 to 08-09) — Flare 08/04–08/07; taper + technique
- Mon Upper A (08/03 pre-flare, moderate):
  - Bench 3x3 @ 7
  - Row 3x5 @ 7
  - DB incline 2x8 @ 6–7
  - Pulldown 2x10 @ 6–7
- Tue–Thu (08/04–08/07, Restricted-Days — light, optional):
  - Choose 2 short sessions (30–40 min), separated by a day:
    - Session A (Lower light): Goblet squat 3x6 @ 6; DB RDL 3x8 @ 6; Leg curl 2x10; Walk 15–20 min
    - Session B (Upper light): Seated DB OHP 3x6 @ 6; Chest-supported row 3x8 @ 6; Cable press 2x10; Face pull 2x12
  - Mobility/breathing 10–15 min each day
- Sat (08/08) Upper/Lower re-entry:
  - Technique singles at 75% on squat, bench, deadlift: 3 singles each @ RPE ~6–6.5, then stop
  - Accessory: Hip thrust 2x6 @ 6–7; Lat pulldown 2x8 @ 6–7

Week 11 (08-10 to 08-16) — Post-flare build; near-peak
- Mon Lower A:
  - Back squat 4x2 @ 8–8.5
  - Hip thrust 3x4 @ 8
  - Split squat 3x6/side
- Tue Upper A:
  - Bench 4x2 @ 8–8.5
  - Weighted pull-up 4x2–3 @ 8
  - Incline DB 3x6
- Thu Lower B:
  - Deadlift 4x1–2 @ 8–8.5 (practice crisp singles)
  - Front squat 3x2–3 @ 7–8
  - Leg press 3x8
- Sat Upper B:
  - OHP 4x2 @ 8
  - Row 3x6–8
  - Close-grip bench 3x4–5

Week 12 (08-17 to 08-23) — Consolidation and submax “tests” (Period predicted 08/20–08/23; plan early-week tests)
- Mon Test session A (Squat + Bench):
  - Back squat: Work to a safe top triple @ ~8 RPE, then 2x3 at 90% of that top set
  - Bench press: Top triple @ ~8 RPE, then 2x3 at 90%
  - Accessories: Hip thrust 2x5 @ 7–8; Row 2x6–8 @ 7
- Tue Easy recovery cardio 20–25 min + mobility
- Thu Test session B (Deadlift + OHP) — aim before flow; if flow starts early, use restricted substitutions:
  - Deadlift: Work to a top double @ ~8 RPE, then 2x2 at 90%
  - OHP: Top triple @ ~8 RPE, then 2x3 at 90%
  - Accessories: Pulldown 2x6–8 @ 7; Back extension 2x8 @ 7
- Sat If on flow (likely): Restricted-Day light circuit 25–35 min:
  - Seated leg press 3x10 @ 6–7
  - Seated row 3x10 @ 6–7
  - Cable chest press 3x10 @ 6–7
  - Bird dog 2x8/side, Pallof 2x10/side

Restricted-Day substitution rules (use any time on flow/flare days)
- Replace:
  - Heavy barbell squats/deads with: safety bar or goblet squat; trap-bar or DB RDL; leg press; tempo work
  - Heavy bench/OHP with: dumbbell presses seated or incline; landmine presses; machines/cables
  - Plyos/HIIT with: walking, easy cycling, incline treadmill; avoid sprints, jumps
- Technique:
  - No heavy Valsalva; cue “brace-light, exhale through the sticking point”
  - Cap sets at RPE 6–7; avoid grinders; fewer total sets if symptoms flare

Conditioning and mobility
- On non-restricted days: 2x/wk Zone 2, 20–30 min (bike, brisk walk, elliptical)
- On restricted days: light walks 10–20 min as tolerated
- Mobility: 10–15 min post-lift focusing on hips (90/90, hip flexor), T-spine extensions, adductors, gentle pelvic floor relaxation breathing (2–3 min)

Recovery and lifestyle notes
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; consistent schedule
- Heat therapy as needed during flares/period (10–20 min abdominal/low-back)
- If pain spikes >3/10 or fatigue overwhelms, drop one main lift that day and keep only accessories at RPE ≤6
- Track symptoms daily; if a predicted heavy day lands on unexpected high-symptom day, switch with a lighter day in the week

Nutrition (general, non-medical guidance)
- Protein: ~1.6–2.2 g/kg/day
- Carbs: Emphasize around training; on heavy days 3–5 g/kg; on restricted days 2–3 g/kg
- Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day; include omega-3 sources (e.g., fish) 2–3x/week
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; add 500–750 ml on training days
- Pre-training: 20–30 g protein + 30–60 g carbs 60–90 min pre
- Post-training: 20–30 g protein + 30–60 g carbs within 2 hours
- During flow/flare: prioritize easy-to-digest carbs, electrolytes if appetite low; consider warm, anti-inflammatory meals (e.g., salmon, turmeric/ginger, berries, leafy greens)

Monitoring and adjustments
- Use RPE logs and symptom notes; progress loads only when sets are clean with 1–2 RIR
- If a flare extends or period symptoms are heavier than usual, default to Restricted-Day format until symptoms subside, then rejoin plan where you left off
- Communicate weekly to confirm cycle timing; shift “push” weeks to the follicular phase and schedule deload elements around luteal/flare windows as needed

This structure gives clear heavy versus light weeks aligned to her anticipated cycles and flare windows, with safe substitutions and autoregulation built in so she can keep momentum without provoking symptoms.
